steps.input:
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    fg = [[i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg] for row in grid]
    for a in range(h):
        for b in range(a + 1, h):
            sa, sb = set(fg[a]), set(fg[b])
            if not sa or not sb or sa == sb:
                continue
            small, large = (a, b) if sa < sb else (b, a) if sb < sa else (None, None)
            if small is None:
                continue
            ss, ls = set(fg[small]), set(fg[large])
            if len(ss) / len(ls) < 0.5:
                continue
            if all(grid[small][c] == grid[large][c] for c in ss) and all(grid[large][c] == grid[small][c] or grid[small][c] == bg for c in ls):
                for c in ls - ss:
                    out[small][c] = 1
    return out
'''
